verdict.rationale: Abacum's marketing claims 'live actuals' and 'real-time consolidation' from connected ERPs. Nothing in the evidence documents a per-source last-synced indicator or a documented refresh schedule after the close. Generic 'live' freshness claims are adjacent marketing, not the story's sync-status visibility or scheduled-refresh capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, each connected source shows when it last synced, and data refreshes on a documented schedule after the close
